in_arabic.name: Ghutayf
in_arabic.long_meaning: Ghutayf هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'gh-t-y', meaning 'to hunt'. In Islamic history, Ghutayf is the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was known for his skill as a hunter. The name symbolizes bravery, determination, and a connection to nature.
